title: M-02877: Chorus key cache for shells, per-pane session vars in herdr, personal Signet 0.237.9
intent: pi starts without Chorus warnings and on team Signet in every herdr pane, even while secretspec cannot decrypt; the personal Signet container and pi's Signet extension carry the upstream fixes (signetai#2076-#2079)
proof_hooks: nix build of the M-02877 Home Manager activation package and darwin system succeeds (shellcheck passes on chorus-api-key and chorus-pi-daemon)
chorus-api-key with secretspec failing serves the cache; Chorus MCP initialize answers 200 with it and 401 with a bad key
zsh with a stale herdr env and a new HERDR_PANE_ID gets SIGNET_DAEMON_URL=3860, SIGNET_AGENT_ID=tao.hansen and CHORUS_API_KEY; a nested shell in the same pane keeps the guard
activation changes only the chorus-pi-daemon plist, .zshenv and .zshrc; the daemon re-registers; the chorusCli step no longer reinstalls
personal Signet on 3850 reports 0.237.9; signet-pi.js contains SIGNET_PROMPT_SUBMIT_TIMEOUT; the built signet-container plist has AbandonProcessGroup and image 0.237.9
